title: All you need is a screwdriver. Lies upon lies
text: All you need is a screwdriver. Lies upon lies. The instructions say all you need is a screwdriver but that is the furthest thing from the truth. It was mission impossible getting the nails completely inside the wooden rods to make a tight fit. I'm going to have to borrow a drill to complete the task. Also it's very easily scratched, that won't bode well if you have kids crazy as mine.
